parameters.body/body/messageBody:
{
  "type": "AdaptiveCard",
  "$schema": "http://adaptivecards.io/schemas/adaptive-card.json",
  "version": "1.4",
  "body": [
    { "type": "TextBlock", "text": "@{variables('errorMessage')}", "color": "Attention", "wrap": true },
    { "type": "TextBlock", "text": "New issue reported!", "weight": "Bolder", "size": "Medium" },
    { "type": "TextBlock", "text": "@{outputs('Get_new_ticket')?['body/f26c_id']}", "wrap": true },
    { "type": "TextBlock", "text": "@{outputs('Get_new_ticket')?['body/f26c_title']}", "wrap": true },
    { "type": "TextBlock", "text": "Summary of issue: @{outputs('Get_new_ticket')?['body/f26c_summary']}", "wrap": true },
    { "type": "TextBlock", "text": "Est. Severity: @{outputs('Get_new_ticket')?['body/cr36f_severitylmh']}", "wrap": true },
    { "type": "TextBlock", "text": "Recommended Department: @{outputs('Get_department')?['body/f26c_name']}", "wrap": true},
    {
      "type": "Input.Text",
      "id": "notes",
      "label": "Notes (required only if skipping)",
      "placeholder": "If this isn't for your team, explain why you're skipping it and/or which department/person you think should claim this.",
      "isMultiline": true,
      "maxLength": 3900
    }
  ],
  "actions": [
    { "type": "Action.Submit", "title": "Take Ticket", "data": { "action": "claim" } },
    { "type": "Action.Submit", "title": "Skip (not for our team)", "data": { "action": "skip" } }
  ]
}

inputs.name: errorMessage
inputs.value: @if(variables('isValid'), '', 'Please explain in the notes why you are skipping this ticket.')
